W.note: A tidy pill that opens into a card with status, ETA, carrier, tracking number, a four-step timeline and clear actions, with aria-expanded, inert body when closed and Escape to collapse; the two-line wrapping of step labels and the odd scale-in frame keep it from top marks.

X.note: A clean package list with labeled remove buttons and aria-expanded, but it starts expanded, collapses to a bare header, and gives no timeline, ETA, tracking number or next-step guidance.

Y.note: The strongest response: a compact status pill that expands into a monospaced UPS tracking number, a dated timeline with locations, ETA and next-step actions, plus a labeled Track button to reopen after dismissal, aria-live and Escape handling.

Z.note: The collapsed bar shows only a dot and a count with no status text, the expanded body shows skeleton placeholders and a literal 'Northwind Post · undefined', and the open frames render blank, so the state is hard to read and the carrier data is broken.
